Angelic Ascension.oracle_text: Exile target creature or planeswalker. Its controller creates a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.

Baneslayer Angel.oracle_text: Flying, first strike, lifelink, protection from Demons and from Dragons

Basri's Acolyte.oracle_text:
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two other target creatures you control.

Brightmare.oracle_text: When this creature enters, tap up to one target creature. You gain life equal to that creature's power.

Celestial Enforcer.oracle_text: {1}{W}, {T}: Tap target creature. Activate only if you control a creature with flying.

Challenger Troll.oracle_text: Each creature you control with power 4 or greater can't be blocked by more than one creature.

Emancipation Angel.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, return a permanent you control to its owner's hand.

Gaea's Protector.oracle_text: This creature must be blocked if able.

Light of Promise.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature."

Mesa Unicorn.oracle_text: Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)

Rampaging Growth.oracle_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle. Until end of turn, that land becomes a 4/3 Insect creature with reach and haste. It's still a land.

Rhonas the Indomitable.oracle_text:
Deathtouch, indestructible
Rhonas can't attack or block unless you control another creature with power 4 or greater.
{2}{G}: Another target creature gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn.

Savage Punch.oracle_text:
Target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.
Ferocious — The creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn before it fights if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.

Speaker of the Heavens.oracle_text:
Vigilance, lifelink (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap. Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
{T}: Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying. Activate only if you have at least 7 life more than your starting life total and only as a sorcery.

annotations.description: Mulliganed a 7-card hand with 4 lands and a reasonable white curve (Turn 3 Celestial Enforcer, Turn 4 Basri's Acolyte + Angelic Ascension as removal). While the hand lacks green mana in what appears to be a GW deck, the white cards provide a functional game plan and natural draws should find green sources.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has a solid curve with 3 playable white spells and 4 lands. Drawing into green sources is likely given 33 cards remaining in library. Mulliganing to 6 risks a worse hand with no guarantee of green mana.

annotations.description: Played Gaea's Protector instead of using Savage Punch to kill Speaker of the Heavens, the engine generating 4/4 Angel tokens every turn. Each turn Speaker survives produces another 4/4 flyer, rapidly making the board unwinnable. With Ferocious active (Rhonas is power 5), Savage Punch would give Rhonas +2/+2 and let it fight and kill Speaker easily.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Gaea's Protector for 4 mana, deploying a 4/2 body but leaving Speaker of the Heavens alive to generate another Angel token next turn.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Savage Punch (2 mana) targeting Rhonas to fight Speaker of the Heavens, killing the Angel-generating engine immediately. This leaves 2 mana open for Rhonas's pump ability if needed, and Gaea's Protector can be deployed next turn.

annotations.description: Gem3P Coach is at exactly 27 life — the threshold for Speaker of the Heavens to create 4/4 Angel tokens (need 27+ with starting life 20). Taking 5 from Rhonas drops them to 22, losing the Speaker activation ability which is their primary win condition engine. Blocking with Brightmare (2/3) would save 5 life and preserve the threshold, at the cost of losing a 2/3 to Rhonas's deathtouch — a very favorable trade in context.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to block Rhonas the Indomitable, taking 5 damage and dropping to 22 life (below Speaker threshold).
annotations.betterLine: Block Rhonas with Brightmare (2/3) to prevent 5 damage and maintain the 27+ life threshold needed for Speaker of the Heavens to keep generating 4/4 Angel tokens.

annotations.description: Held back Brightmare from attacking when the opponent had no available blockers (Rhonas tapped, Gaea's Protector sick). This left 2 free damage on the table, reducing the attack from 9 to 7 damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Angel Token (5/5) and Speaker of the Heavens (2/2) for 7 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all three available creatures (Angel Token, Speaker of the Heavens, and Brightmare) for 9 total damage since the opponent has zero available blockers. The 2/3 Brightmare provides minimal defensive value against the opponent's 5/5 and 4/2 threats.

annotations.description: Chose Angelic Edict over Baneslayer Angel. While exiling Rhonas (indestructible, deathtouch) is a strong play, casting Baneslayer Angel creates an overwhelming air clock: two 5/5 flyers threaten 10 damage next turn against an opponent at 13 life with no flyers. The opponent's board is fully tapped and can't interact this turn. Baneslayer's lifelink also cushions any counterattack. The Edict can be cast next turn when the mana is available again.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Angelic Edict to exile an opponent's creature (likely Rhonas)
annotations.betterLine: Cast Baneslayer Angel to create a 2-turn lethal clock in the air (10 flying damage per turn vs opponent at 13 life) with lifelink to buffer against counterattacks. Save Angelic Edict for next turn if needed.

annotations.description: At 4 life facing a 5/5 flying Angel token (plus two 2/3s), casting Rampaging Growth enables an attack this turn but the 4/3 reach land-creature expires at end of turn, leaving no way to block the Angel next turn. Opponent swings for 9+ in the air and on ground, which is lethal. Savage Punch with Ferocious (Rhonas becomes 7/7, indestructible) kills the Angel permanently, and then Rhonas can block ground threats next turn to survive.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Rampaging Growth to create a temporary 4/3 reach/haste attacker and enable Rhonas to attack.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Savage Punch targeting Rhonas and the Angel Token 5/5. Rhonas gets +2/+2 from Ferocious, fights as a 7/5 indestructible, kills the Angel. Then play a land and pass. Next turn, block ground threats with indestructible Rhonas and survive.

annotations.description: At 4 life facing a 5/5 flying Angel Token that will attack for lethal next turn, the player passed instead of casting Savage Punch to kill it. Rhonas the Indomitable (indestructible, 5/5) can fight the Angel Token via Savage Punch, getting +2/+2 from Ferocious to become 7/5 with deathtouch, easily destroying the Angel while surviving due to indestructible. Without removing the Angel, the opponent attacks for lethal in the air next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn without casting Savage Punch
annotations.betterLine: Cast Savage Punch targeting Rhonas the Indomitable to fight the Angel Token 5/5. With Ferocious, Rhonas becomes 7/5 with deathtouch and indestructible, killing the Angel and surviving. This removes the only lethal flying threat.
